description:
Best execution for selling `amount` of token `sell` (or `amount_usd` worth) for token `buy`, on
    every venue that can make the trade on its own markets in one or two swaps: an AMM pool (Cantex,
    Tradecraft, OneSwap, Pool Party), an order book (Temple, Rocky), or two of them in a row on the same
    venue (Temple: CC to USDCx, then USDCx to CBTC; Pool Party: CC to USDC.B, then USDC.B to CBTC). The
    same comparison as the site's best execution, at any size. Pool fees, book fees and price impact are
    included; `after_network_fee` also takes off the venue's per-trade network fee on each swap (the fee
    table, with which fees are measured, documented or assumed, is in `network_fees`). A pool whose
    reserves have stood still while its price left the market is no market here (`not_trading`). A
    venue whose route takes an order book that shows more of a token than exists (a side larger than its
    registry's total supply) carries `book_shows_more_than_exists`: its price, not a size it can fill.

amount.description: How much of the sold token, in its own units. Give this or amount_usd, not both
amount.title: Amount

amount_usd.description: Size of the sale in US dollars at our price of the sold token. Give this or amount, not both
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

buy.description: Symbol of the token bought, e.g. USDCx
buy.title: Buy

sell.description: Symbol of the token sold, e.g. CC
sell.title: Sell
